title: Sufficiently narrow concise order-three tensors over any field have maximal asymptotic subrank equal to their fixed third dimension
author: Jop Briët, Matthias Christandl, Itai Leigh, Amir Shpilka and Jeroen Zuiddam
difficulty_reason: The proof restricts a bounded-dimensional matrix space to simultaneously diagonal submatrices and converts large maximal rank into a uniform minimum-rank bound. It proves supermultiplicativity and controls mixed tensor powers even when some restricted factors vanish. Chernoff counting supplies exponentially many independent high-minimum-rank slices, and an explicit diagonal-unit extraction turns them into maximal asymptotic subrank.
